invariants.rationale: Line indices in UI widgets are typically non-negative; updateCurrentLine likely maintains this.
Cursors are generally not negative in a text UI.
Array/collection for line breaks must exist for the method operations.
Text must be present for 'text.length()' and 'text.charAt()' calls to be executed.
The code appears to treat linesBreak as an array with even number of elements representing line breaks.
